summary.en: Encode Desktop phone-tab swipes as WDA press-hold gestures so iOS Simulator UI scrolls.
summary.zh: 把桌面端手机 tab 的 swipe 编成 WDA 按住手势，使 iOS Simulator 界面可以滚动。

compatibilityExceptions.reason: Phone-tab swipe encoding runs in the Desktop Host and Web client; it does not change Mobile source, build inputs, or artifacts.
The local phone-tab gesture encoding does not change Platform services, deployment inputs, or wire formats.
